cases.name: weather: known user gets a real reading
cases.why: The whole point of the tool-calling pattern is that the agent fetches this.

cases.name: weather: reading comes from the tool, not the model
cases.why: The agent was once observed answering with a temperature it never fetched. The trace is how that stays visible.

cases.name: weather: unknown user gets nulls, not a plausible number
cases.why: A fabricated 0.0 reads as a real measurement and is worse than an error.

cases.name: rag: finds the fruit the person likes
cases.why: Retrieval has to surface the passages that answer the question.

cases.name: rag: distinguishes liked from hated
cases.why: The knowledge base contains both, phrased almost identically, so this is where naive similarity search goes wrong.

cases.name: rag: searches twice for a two-part question
cases.why: Agentic retrieval means the model may search again; this is that case.

cases.name: rag: declines what the knowledge base cannot answer
cases.why: Answering from the model instead is the failure RAG exists to prevent.
